Implemented Task 004 project renaming in commit `17424a0607e0d2451105674fd53dbf2b242a7401`.

Active projects can be renamed with trimmed names. Blank names show the required alert, and archived projects cannot be renamed. The rename persists while preserving the project ID and existing tasks.

Verified the rename API, health endpoint, blank-name rejection, `git diff --check`, and clean Git status. Run with `npm start`; the submission tree is clean.
